Each cluster represents a distinct analytical scenario, with its probability derived from the proportion of contributing input scenarios. Dualities arise in how DTW balances local similarity with global alignment, and how aggregation reduces dimensionality while preserving predictive utility. The method assumes stationarity in weather pattern behavior over short time horizons.
